name: Yetini · Gremlet #22
description:
A yeti cub with big soft feet. Leaves tiny footprints nobody can explain.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Yetini in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
